integrity: Analytic proof with independent symbolic identity script and sampled consistency checks; no claim of independent external certification.
scientific_limitations: Exact first-event classification only for equal-growth, two-site, antisymmetric coupling 0<s<1; not a global attractor or post-bifurcation classification. title: A four-region first-instability chart for an antisymmetric two-site clipped logistic map
